headline: Granted water and sewer bill abatements for nine properties and denied one at 49 Glen Rock Avenue.
summary: The Commission reviewed several requests for water and sewer bill abatements due to leaks, faulty toilet flappers, or billing errors, and granted adjustments ranging from $159.59 to $1,250.71 for nine properties. The Commission denied an abatement for 49 Glen Rock Avenue, finding the bills consistent with normal usage. The Chairman also signed a letter discharging a 1938 betterment assessment lien on property now owned by Olympia Apartments LLC.
decisions: Signed a Municipal Charges Lien Discharge letter releasing the Neal Street Area Betterment Assessment on the property now titled to Olympia Apartments LLC.
